95: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.
351: When a beautiful first-grade teacher arrives at a prep school, she soon attracts the attention of an ambitious teenager named Max, who quickly falls in love with her. Max turns to the father of two of his schoolmates for advice on how to woo the teacher. However, the situation soon gets complicated when Max's new friend becomes involved with her, setting the two pals against one another in a war for her attention.
607: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.
What is hidden in snow, comes forth in the thaw.
863: The story of the life and career of eccentric avant-garde comedian, Andy Kaufman.
Hello, my name is Andy and this is my movie.
1119: Three wealthy children's parents are killed in a fire. When they are sent to a distant relative, they find out that he is plotting to kill them and seize their fortune.
Count Olaf / Dr. Stephano / Captain Sham

But things get a lot more complicated when V falls in love with Tom, a single father who is unaware of her real profession.

They're coming to take on Broadway!

2655: Manny, Diego, and Sid embark upon another adventure after their continent is set adrift. Using an iceberg as a ship, they encounter sea creatures and battle pirates as they explore a new world.
The end of the world is just the tip of the iceberg.
2911: Jonathan Switcher, an unemployed artist, finds a job as an assistant window dresser for a department store. When Jonathan happens upon a beautiful mannequin he previously designed, she springs to life and introduces herself as Emmy, an Egyptian under an ancient spell. Despite interference from the store's devious manager, Jonathan and his mannequin fall in love while creating eye-catching window displays to keep the struggling store in business.
Just because Jonathan's fallen in love with a piece of wood, it doesn't make him a dummy.
3167: A young girl comes to an embittered town and confronts its attitude with her determination to see the best in life.
3423: Plagued with grief over the murder of her daughter, Valerie Somers suspects that her husband John is cheating on her. 3679: When average, law-abiding citizens suddenly turn to a life of hedonistic behavior and violent crime, Detective Tom Beck is tasked with helping young FBI agent Lloyd Gallagher determine the cause.
It's only human on the outside...
3935: During a shootout in a saloon, Sheriff Hunt injures a suspicious stranger. The doctor's assistant, wife of the local foreman, tends to him in prison. That night, the town is attacked and they both disappear—only the arrow of a cannibal tribe is found. Hunt and a few of his men go in search of the prisoner and the foreman's wife.
4191: After a botched robbery results in the brutal murder of a rural family, two drifters elude police, in the end coming to terms with their own mortality and the repercussions of their vile atrocity.
The crime that shocked a nation.
4447: Two police officers struggle to survive when they become trapped beneath the rubble of the World Trade Center on September 11, 2001.
The world saw evil that day. Two men saw something else.
4703: Three macabre tales from the latest issue of a boy's favorite comic book, dealing with a vengeful wooden Native American, a monstrous blob in a lake, and an undying hitchhiker.
When the curtain goes up, the terror begins.
4959: When a crass new-money tycoon's membership application is turned down at a snooty country club, he retaliates by buying the club and turning it into a tacky amusement park.
5215: A wealthy woman's yachting holiday with friends in the Mediterranean Sea takes an unexpected turn when she and one of the boat's crew are stranded on a desert island. Her capitalist beliefs and his communist convictions clash, but during their struggle to survive, social roles are reversed and heated passions come alive.
un giornalista di sinistra conoscente dei Pavone Lanzetti
5471: A chronicle of the rise and fall of O.J. Simpson, whose high-profile murder trial exposed the extent of American racial tensions, revealing a fractured and divided nation.
5727: A bad day gets worse for young detective Murakami when a pickpocket steals his gun on a hot, crowded bus. The Suspense Filled Story of 7 Bullets!
5983: Nick, a gay, HIV-positive architect, begins to display severe symptoms of AIDS and makes preparations to kill himself before he is unable to function normally. A gathering of friends. A gift of love. A celebration of life.
6239: After starting at an upmarket boarding school, a teenage girl forms close friendships with her two older roommates. However, when she discovers that her new friends are lovers she finds herself caught in a complicated situation.
6751: The history of American popular music runs parallel with the history of a Russian Jewish immigrant family, with each male descendant possessing different musical abilities.
All those years, all those dreams, all those sons... one of them is going to be a star.

7263: A man on the run takes another man's passport, only to find himself stuck with the identity of a street hustler.
One big shot. One big mouth. The switch is on.
7519: Wealthy executive Drew Latham has no close relationships and becomes nostalgic for his childhood home as Christmas approaches. When he visits the house and finds another family living there, he offers the residents a large sum of money to pretend they are his parents.
This year, Christmas comes early. Really early.
7775: When troubled musical prodigy Charlotte seeks out Elizabeth, the new star pupil of her former school, the encounter sends both musicians down a sinister path with shocking consequences.
It's Time to Face the Music.
8031: A driver and mechanic drag racing for money cross paths with a female hitchhiker and a drifter who challenges them to a cross-country race.
no beginning... no end... no speed limit...
8287: Four thirtysomethings convene for a wine-fueled dinner party that turns increasingly intimate as they discuss everything from religion and ghosts to relationships and sexual fetishes.
Sex, religion, infidelity, fetishes, ghosts... and that's just the appetizer.
8799: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely.
9055: A Korean man in China takes an assassination job in South Korea to make money and find his missing wife. But when the job is botched, he is forced to go on the run from the police and the gangsters who paid him.
The only thing he must not have crossed.
9311: The story of Captain Richard Francis Burton's and Lt. John Hanning Speke's expedition to find the source of the Nile river in the name of Queen Victoria's British Empire.
Two strangers made friends by a savage land. Two friends made enemies by the civilized world.
9567: Dodger, a criminal monkey, belongs to a crooked street performer but escapes his life of crime only to end up in the arms of Eva, an innocent little girl whose mother has no idea that her daughter is harboring a fugitive.
Eva's new friend has big eyes, hairy feet, and very sticky fingers.
9823: In a quicksand surrounded town called Makka, rumors spread of a legendary robber named Gasback is after the town. To protect it, Mayor Kepler has hired bounty hunters. These hunters have been following Gasback from town to town in hopes of getting the bounty. Vash the Stampede is in town, along with Meryl and Milly, along with the female bounty hunter Amelia and Nicholas D. Wolfwood.
10079: Before he left for a brief European visit, symphony conductor Sir Alfred De Carter casually asked his staid brother-in-law August to look out for his young wife, Daphne, during his absence. 10335: German artist Kurt Barnert has escaped East Germany and now lives in West Germany, but is tormented by his childhood under the Nazis and the GDR regime.
10591: The buttoned-down, superstitious Kay is attempting to lead a normal existence with her new boyfriend Louis. There will not be a more extraordinary film than “Sweetie” in a long long time!
10847: A Jewish strongman performs in Berlin as the blond Aryan hero Siegfried.
11103: Harry Burck has been kidnapped by South American terrorists, and when the US Government refuses to intervene, Harry's friends decide to take matters into their own hands!
An adventure about the hero in all of us

Mean Streets was just around the corner.

A terrifying drama of love and murder!

Little we know or imagine can prepare us for the fierce and punishing impact of The Boys.
12127: Paloma is a serious and highly articulate but deeply bored 11-year-old who has decided to kill herself on her 12th birthday. 12383: A redneck with an uncanny knack for getting arrested becomes the star of his own reality program.
He didn’t get his 15 minutes of fame… He stole it.

Terry Twillstein / Wolfgang Amadeus Thelonius Von Funkenmeister the XIX 3 / 4 / Daffy Mal Yinkle Yankle

Aided by his mother, the two maintained a stable of not so innocent studs.
12895: In New York, a Pakistani native finds that his American Dream has collapsed in the wake of the 9/11 terrorist attacks.

When his own wife falls victim to this mysterious power, the old man takes it upon himself to destroy the glowing object with disastrous results.
No one can stop this killing machine....It's Already Dead!!!

This is Jimmy, balanced on the ragged edge of violence, twisted and trapped by a world he never made…

The uncanny master of make-up in a new amazing shocker!
14431: An engrossing spectacle set in the 4th-century BC, in which Alexander of Greece leads his troops forth, conquering all of the known world, in the belief that the Greek way of thinking will bring enlightenment to people. The colossus who conquered the world!
14687: A cautionary tale for these times of democracy in crisis—the personal and political fuse to explore one of the most dramatic periods in Brazilian history. The only thing that can stop you is you.

When Subrata loses his job, the power dynamic begins to shift.

Four went. Three came back. Only one of them knows what happened.
15711: Nine translators, hired to translate the eagerly awaited final book of a bestselling trilogy, are confined in a luxurious bunker.
16479: A.D. 2400, DEVA's central council detects an incident of unauthorized access into their mainframe. Someone on Earth was trying to hack into the system. Angela intercepts the gruesome pests with her exoskeleton powered suit Arhan.
16735: After Doug picks up hitchhiking Rosco with his truck, they are mistaken for two bank robbers by the traffic police. They manage to escape  only to be confused for two secret agents while trying to take a flight at the airport.
16991: When two bus crash survivors awake to discover that they are the only people left in their small town, they must form an unlikely alliance in a race to unravel the truth behind their isolation. 17247: The plot follows three friends in New York City whose lives are upended by the 9/11 attacks leading to suspicion, FBI involvement, and a story about friendship, identity, and the aftermath of terrorism.
Three friends ready to face the world... and then the world changed.

1966. They were looking for John Lennon and found themselves.

In matters of love and sex... every good boy does fine.

18527: As the Germans drop explosive booby-traps on 1943 Britain, the embittered expert who'll have to disarm them fights a private battle with alcohol.

Getting the Life You Want Means Losing the Life You Have.

It makes him very popular with the locals but most certainly does not help with his bank account. 20319: Alice, an obsessed Woody Allen fan, meets Pierre in a night-club and falls in love with him. But when Pierre sees Alice's sister Hélène, things start to get complicated.
20575: Blacklisted by the major airlines for endlessly chasing female staff, pilot Rick Richards returns to Hawaii to set up a helicopter charter company with his friend Danny. Having a girl on every island is a good way to get business but it becomes clear that romance and flying don't always mix.

Nothing this fabulous could last forever
21087: An introvert relieves the tedium of caring for his invalid mother by spying on his neighbor.
21343: While on vacation in Rome, married American Mary Forbes becomes entangled in an affair with an Italian man, Giovanni Doria. Together they wander the railroad station where Mary is to take the train to Paris, then ultimately reunite with her husband and daughter in Philadelphia. Will she throw away her old life for this passionate new romance?
This Longing ... This Yearning ... This Wanting ...

22111: Two brothers compete in their own private 25-event Olympics.
22367: During the Russian Civil War, the production of a silent melodrama runs into numerous complications.
22623: A concert violinist becomes charmed with his daughter's talented piano teacher. When he invites her to go on tour with him, they make beautiful music away from the concert hall as well. He soon leaves his wife so the two can go off together.

But baby-sitting overnight unexpectedly turns into a week, and Kate's life spins into chaos. As Maddie reveals stories of being bullied and of wanting to run away and be a Juggalo, the two form a unique bond.
23135: Two cabbies search San Francisco's Chinatown for a mysterious character who has disappeared with their $4000. 23391: Two conspiracy obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.
Of all the abductions, this one is different.
23647: Kabir and his family's fun weekend retreat takes terrifying turn when an intruder takes over the control of the  body of his teenage daughter, putting her at the mercy of his increasingly sinister orders.
23903: After tracing the origin of a disturbing supernatural affliction to a wealthy family's ancestral gravesite, a team of paranormal experts relocates the remains—and soon discovers what happens to those who dare to mess with the wrong grave.

24415: Based on a real-life historic court case, a bold journalist questions a revered leader's immoral behavior.
24671: A cop's inquiry into child kidnappings unravels chilling secrets as supernatural events endanger his family and the peaceful town of Baramulla.

25183: When a young fisherman with a hidden talent gets discovered by a music producer, he must decide if he's ready to open himself up to stardom — and love.

Some secrets are better left buried.
25951: Once a year a group of handicapped people are allowed to visit army barracks. There, they have the opportunity of feeling like and being real soldiers.
26207: During their vacation in the French countryside, a wealthy German family becomes entangled with a young hotel worker harboring sinister intentions.

What mysterious force is driving them? And how do the long-buried secrets of the Monitor and Supergirl threaten to crush our last defense?
26719: A mysterious woman on the run, and the resourceful fixer assigned to bring her in. Their two unique stories inextricably link, as the stakes of the pursuit rise to apocalyptic proportions.

27231: In this documentary, wealthy entrepreneur Bryan Johnson puts his body and fortune on the line to defy aging and extend his life beyond all known limits.
27487: Four friends head to Hawaii to investigate reports of a haunting at an abandoned resort in hopes of finding the infamous Half-Faced Girl. When they arrive, they soon learn you should be careful what you wish for.

Princess Rudrama Devi / Prince Rudradeva Maharaja

Roma follows him to Calcutta.

ICE in her veins... ICICLES on her heart!

Here lies Daisuke Jigen with .357 Magnum died 1st Apr, 19... Rest in peace.

Anna Mikhaylovna, assistant to the president

It's the Book with a Heartful of Love that Thrilled Millions!

The Story of a free woman and her romances!
